name: Quest Hotel and Conference Center Cebu
detail: i originally planned on staying at the quest hotel for a week, but ended up staying a month. value for money when i was here in may-june 2012 the value for money was incredible. i paid around us per night without breakfast. by comparison, the cebu marriott, was running around us per night – a little over twice the price, and i imagine no better quality. i looked at half a dozen hotels in cebu before settling on quest. other hotels in cebu running in the $50 - $60 range don’t even come close in terms of quality. and my high expectations were met after i moved in. location the location is great, right across the street from the ayala mall, which is the most upscale mall in cebu. ayala a good place to hang out with plenty of restaurants and coffee shops with fast internet connections. (unfortunately, like most hotels the internet connection at quest is a slower than i would like for my work.) quality the hotel is brand new. when i first arrived they were still finishing outfitting the upper floors. it is impeccably clean and everything is brand new. the rooms are well designed, and the hotel has a clean, spacious feel to it. despite being near a busy road, i heard almost no noise from outside and always slept soundly. food the philippines are not renowned for the food. i haven’t had a meal here that impressed me. having said that, the food in the hotel is the best i have had in the philippines. it’s the same standard as you’d expect of hotel food in a us hotel that knows how to do food well. not just a generic menu designed to serve the lowest common denominator, but actually a good menu with really good food. (they do have all the regulars like steak and burgers, but they do it well.) friendly staff the staff have been consistently friendly and helpful. i feel welcomed every time i enter the hotel at whatever time of day or night.

name: Seda Ayala Center Cebu City
detail: Not all rooms in first-class hotels in Cebu have a bath tub. This one is one such. There are others. This reviewer has a habit of misbehaving in first-class hotels (although not for the bath tub) and he hereby apologises to all Cebu first-class hotels. The Agoda price for three persons was double the price for two persons. Agoda.com went on to find a cheaper price – for three persons - through one of its partners. The Agoda document said – to the hotel – that it – the latter – would be paid, not by Agoda but, through a third party. Upon check-in, with three persons for four nights, we were told, we had only breakfast for two. We didn’t mind. Upon check-out, the breakfasts for the third person were reimbursed.

name: Mandarin Plaza Hotel
detail: The hotel has a gym, pool, and mall across the street.

name: bai Hotel
detail: The Bai Hotel Cebu was an amazing stay. The service, food, room, amenities, and everything about the Bai Hotel was outstanding. Words can't describe the experience during my stay. In the past I stayed at the Marriott at Ayala Mall but if I knew then what I know now I would have stayed at the Bai Hotel. The service by the staff was amazing, room and housekeeping the best and food, off the charts. The best breakfast buffet ever and I'm serious, the Cafe is the best. If you want an experience like never before visit the Twighlight Rooftop Lounge. Keep up the great work Bai Hotel, I will be back again and again when I return to Cebu. The Bai Hotel is Best in Class !!

name: Radisson Blu Cebu
detail: Regarding the Five Star Radisson Blu Hotel in Cebu on a scale of 1 to 5 we rated it at 10! We just had our 12th beautiful experience at the Radisson Blu Hotel in Cebu, Philippines. The staff once again are considerate beyond belief, friendly and helpful making our experience very enjoyable. The food is great, the room service from Aaron and housekeeping from Jenny. Outstanding general attention and kindness from all levels of management and staff including a very warm and extremely hospitable Dazzle, Richard , Sabrina still a trainee but beaming with a promise. and too many persons to be able to cite by name but all of them outstanding and much appreciated. The hotel operators like Farah and Adel are both very helpful and accommodating. Another, impressive memory was during our latest visit when Rose, the business executive manager when learning that I was temporarily ill send her assistant to bring me Gatorade. The staff at the swimming pool have always been extraordinary in their attention to our needs and comfort which we appreciate. We are deeply indebted for the fine service at the pool from Charisma who is always been very kind and thoughtful in making us feel at home and comfortable. The food is excellent with new creations and innovation with their NEW OUTDOOR RESTAURANT you can really dine with the StARS and have Romantic evening with candlelight to make guests love the outdoor meals served including superior and premium steaks that my wife and I dearly loved,that WE DINE 2 nights in a ROW ! Lastly, Sous chef ,Joeffrey and executive chef Roberto Kunitz are wonderful in terms of their service to customers and are much appreciated by this customer and family. A hallmark of this beautiful restaurant is there breakfast Buffet which is the most elegant and varied breakfast buffets I’ve ever tried in my worldwide travels. The food is not only delicious but is served by the staff with loving care and attention to the guests is”exceptionnel”

name: Hop Inn Hotel Cebu City
detail: This is the cleanest hotel room I have ever stayed in.

name: Appleton Boutique Hotel Cebu
detail: It was good to stay in the appleton hotel. I was there for a day while going back to Korea from Bohol. It was another good experiece in Philippines.. The SM hyper market is just across from the hotel and there are a lot of stores to shop and eat. I believe it is much safer than any other place in Cebu and not far from the airport. The employs are kind and breakfast was good for me.

name: Tom's Cabin Hotel
detail: I booked this hotel thinking it's a budget hotel since there is no Go Hotel in Cebu. We arrived the hotel and received a warm and friendly surprise. Since it's still early for their check-in time, they managed to make some rooms available especially for the senior citizen in my travel party. This allowed us to relax before we continue our tour of the city. The budget rooms has the same size as Go Hotel (but the CR is different in feature). It's comfortable and comfortable. We will be back.

name: Castle Peak Hotel
detail: always enjoyable, frequent visitor to cebu city, philippines, from neighboring province. castle peak hotel has consistently provided me and my family with excellent service and good value. we certainly have stayed at far more expensive hotels in cebu city but keep coming back to castle peak for it's location, staff performance, and value

name: Dusit Thani Mactan Cebu Resort
detail: I stayed in a 2 bedroom executive suite and the view is awesome for panoramic photoshoot. Everybody was asking me where is this place since it was something new. They gave me the best stay ever compared to other 5 star hotels in cebu. The food is amazing I love it and it is very delicious. We enjoyed eating at the bar at night and we enjoyed jamming in their acoustic band. The pool is superb. It is more than just a 5 star for me. The staff were so nice, accomodating and friendly. I wanted to mention the staff who accomodated me on that day but I forgot their names. I checked in late on that day around 8 or 9pm there was 1 male at the reception and the other one at the luggage. Sorry guys I know I promised to mention you both on my vlog and feedback but I am bad at names lol I will recommend this to all my overseas relatives and I highly recommend this hotel to everyone. It is worth every penny You will never regret!!!
